title: Container Registry Configuration
description: Configuration schema for matrix container scanning across multiple registries

containers.description: List of container images to scan

name.description: Unique identifier for this container (used in scan artifacts)

image.description: Full container image reference (e.g., nginx:latest, ghcr.io/owner/image:tag, 123456.dkr.ecr.region.amazonaws.com/image:tag)

registry_username.description: Username for registry authentication (can be literal value or reference to secrets)

registry_username_secret.description: Name of the GitHub secret containing registry username

registry_password_secret.description: Name of the GitHub secret containing registry password/token (required for private registries)

scanners.description: List of scanners to run for this container

enable_code_security.description: Whether to upload SARIF to GitHub Security tab

fail_on_severity.description: Fail the scan if vulnerabilities at or above this severity are found

post_pr_comment.description: Whether to post PR comments for this scan
